title: Grateful Dead Live at Alfred College on 1970-05-01
lineage: SBD > MR > DAT > Sonic Solutions > CDR

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of the legendary Alfred College 1970 show, highlighted by a scorching New Speedway Boogie, tight acoustic gems like Love Light and Pigpen, all delivered with crystal‑clear audio.
ai_review.review: The SBD recording is praised for its crisp, clear fidelity that lets listeners hear every nuance—from Jerry’s blistering lead on New Speedway Boogie to the dual‑acoustic interplay between Bob and David Nelson. The set flows smoothly from an acoustic opener (Race Is On, Love Light) into a high‑energy electric second half featuring Pigpen and Cold Jordan, making it one of the standout early‑70 performances. Overall the technical quality matches the musical excitement, earning universal acclaim among fans.

ai_rating.rationale: Over 30 fan reviews, most rating 4‑5 stars, consistently praise both sound quality and performance; only a single modest 3‑star review provides minor dissent.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Multiple reviewers describe the audio as crisp, crystal clear, best live sound ever, with only occasional remarks that it could be a bit better; no significant drop‑outs reported.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Fans love the seamless shift from a two‑guitar acoustic set into an electric second half, noting tight transitions and high energy throughout.

band_member_comments.Jerry: Trade licks on New Speedway Boogie and prominent electric leads; also backs acoustic numbers alongside Bob.
band_member_comments.Bob: Provides rhythm/acoustic guitar on Love Light and other early songs, complementing Jerry's lead work.
